name: Ellis Velvetrope
bio: Never forgets a face, especially one that is not on the list.
notes: New model 2026-11-25 (owner: "many are replacements for what we currently have"; id, name and place kept, as Thornweaver's and Anoobys's swaps). Elephant Warrior's model until 2026-11-25 ("Elephant Warrior", Meshy Community CC0) no longer ships (a community model, not the owner's: owner, 2026-11-25, only the owner's own retired models stay as MapMaker figures). Drive intake of 2026-11-25 ("bouncer elephant 15k", as Meshy names the download; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; its clips are not used, the hands are fitted by hands.mjs). Licence: Meshy, owned: the owner's own Meshy model (owner, 2026-11-25: "all are the owner's own Meshy creations"; standing rule since 2026-11-22). Renamed Ellis Velvetrope (owner, 2026-11-25: Elephant Warrior renamed to a fun personal name that fits the new model, a bouncer; was Elephant Warrior). Pistol hold (2026-11-26): broad shoulders put the support hand 10 cm short of the pistol, so the shooting hand holds it 10 cm in toward the middle (`fixes.holdPistol`).
